messages:
Ivy (CS): OrionHealth onboarding note: token spend jumped ~27% after enabling long-form summaries. p95/p99 tails on >1k tokens increased. Renewal in ~5w. Looking for low-risk perf levers (quant/model mix/routing) with minimal clinical impact.
Marta (OrionHealth): clinicians flagged subtle changes in discharge closing statements. Templates (medlist/bullets) are fine. Freeform diagnostic sections must be exact.
Theo (Solutions): can Orion add a deterministic tag/header for template requests? that'll let us route safely.
Marta (OrionHealth): yes — can add header X-Orion-Template: discharge_v3. ETA 2 dev days. Audited endpoints to be excluded.
Ravi (Eng-ML): plan: 1) int8 compact for template endpoints 2) header-based routing + shadow NLP matcher 3) KV prefix cache for repeats 4) uncertainty detector to fallback to full model 5) small golden eval set (50 notes).
Sam (SRE): ops: enforce cache TTL per PHI policy; will run shadowing then staged canary. Define rollback: quality drop >2% or p99 >4s.
Theo (Solutions): suggested canary sequence: 48h shadow -> 5% for 6h -> 20% for 24h. compact traffic starts at 20% for template-tagged requests. Exclude audited endpoints.
canary-bot: scheduled: shadow=48h -> rollout steps [5,20]; auto-rollback thresholds set. link=https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/5750012345
Ivy (CS): action items: 1) Marta add header + excludes 2) Ravi build eval harness 3) Theo finalize canary config 4) Sam run canary and alerts. I'll include cost delta and rollback criteria in renewal notes.
Marta (OrionHealth): confirmed. will add header and PR in 48h.
Ravi (Eng-ML): will deliver eval results within 72h post-shadow.
Ivy (CS): thanks all — I'll report back after initial shadow metrics. :thumbsup:
